title: 貨運編組場駝峰調速~Hump-yard speed-control systems
focus: 以能量與事件時序理解貨運駝峰調速~Energy accounting and event timing in hump-yard speed control
summary: 本課聚焦以能量與事件時序理解貨運駝峰調速。從坡高與重力能量帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把速度資料年齡與位移與區段軸數與未知狀態連成可驗證的介面，最後以載重與環境試驗邊界整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies energy accounting and event timing in hump-yard speed control. Start with height drop and gravitational energy to define physical or information boundaries, connect data age and continued wagon movement with section axle balance and unknown state as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through load and environment coverage. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對以能量與事件時序理解貨運駝峰調速而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用動能差與平均耗能力及車組任務與路徑狀態連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For energy accounting and event timing in hump-yard speed control, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force and wagon-group assignments and route states. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究坡高與重力能量帳。原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。公式 y=m*g*h/1000，代入得 y=824.04 kJ。邊界：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。敏感度只改 h=1.2 至 1.32 m，輸出變為 906.444 kJ；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究動能差與平均耗能力：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。公式 y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000，代入得 y=40.8333 kN。邊界：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。比較不同質量的原創案例，避免只用坡高猜測到達速度。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate height drop and gravitational energy. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m. Formula y=m*g*h/1000 gives y=824.04 kJ. Boundary: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control. For sensitivity, change only h=1.2 to 1.32 m; the output becomes 906.444 kJ. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m. Formula y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000 gives y=40.8333 kN. Boundary: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. Compare hypothetical wagon masses without predicting arrival speed from height alone. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 坡高與重力能量帳~Height drop and gravitational energy
units.title: 坡高與重力能量帳~Height drop and gravitational energy
units.mechanism: 先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。比較不同質量的原創案例，避免只用坡高猜測到達速度。位能下降可轉成動能與耗散，質量同時影響可用能量和需要消散的能量。駝峰調速的速度結果還受滾動阻力、風與車輛狀態影響；只用高度差決定目標速度會漏掉路徑上的持續損失與偶發阻力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。~Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. Compare hypothetical wagon masses without predicting arrival speed from height alone. Lost gravitational energy becomes kinetic energy and dissipation. Mass affects both available and required dissipated energy. Hump-yard speed also depends on rolling resistance, wind and vehicle condition. Height drop alone cannot determine final speed without accounting for losses along the path. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。公式 y=m*g*h/1000，代入得 y=824.04 kJ。邊界：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m. Formula y=m*g*h/1000 gives y=824.04 kJ. Boundary: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control.
units.verify: 以縮尺斜面比較同高度與不同阻力表面的末速，記錄能量差而非只看是否滑動。以「坡高與重力能量帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Use a scale incline to compare final speeds at equal drop but different resistance, recording the energy difference rather than merely motion. For height drop and gravitational energy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 低阻車輛可能比預測更快，輪軸阻力增加則可能停在途中，兩者都不能靠平均車重辨認。回到「坡高與重力能量帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A low-resistance wagon can exceed the predicted speed, while increased bearing resistance can stop it early; average mass cannot distinguish either condition. Trace the input chain for height drop and gravitational energy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度~Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons.
units.practice: 只把下降高度 h 從 1.2 改成 1.32 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 824.04 變為 906.444 kJ。先說明「坡高與重力能量帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only vertical drop h from 1.2 to 1.32 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 824.04 to 906.444 kJ. Explain the causal direction for height drop and gravitational energy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 動能差與平均耗能力~Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force
units.title: 動能差與平均耗能力~Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force
units.mechanism: 把入口與出口速度各自平方後建立能量差，觀察入口速度小幅偏差的放大效果。再把平均力與沿程峰值區分，不能從一個平均量推論接觸力分布。所需平均耗能力可由動能差除以作用距離估算，初速平方使高速偏差特別敏感。平均力不是峰值力，也不會描述濕滑、延遲和接觸分布；調速結果必須同時檢查能量帳、末速與沿程減速度。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。~Use squared entry and exit speeds to obtain the energy change and observe sensitivity to entry-speed error. Distinguish mean force from local peaks instead of inferring the contact distribution from one average. Required mean dissipating force follows kinetic-energy change divided by distance, making high initial-speed errors particularly influential. Mean force is not peak force and does not describe wet contact, delay or force distribution. Verification needs energy, exit speed and deceleration along the path together. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。公式 y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000，代入得 y=40.8333 kN。邊界：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m. Formula y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000 gives y=40.8333 kN. Boundary: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings.
units.verify: 在離線模型比較能量積分與末速度，將接觸延遲及作用長度誤差各自改變。以「動能差與平均耗能力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~In an offline model, compare integrated energy with exit speed and vary contact delay and effective length independently. For kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 作用延遲縮短有效距離時，即使平均接觸力沒變也可能留下過高末速；速度感測偏差會誤導診斷。回到「動能差與平均耗能力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Delayed action shortens effective distance and raises exit speed despite unchanged contact force; biased speed sensing can obscure the cause. Trace the input chain for kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同~Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed.
units.practice: 只把初速 v0 從 5 改成 5.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40.8333 變為 51.0417 kN。先說明「動能差與平均耗能力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only initial speed v0 from 5 to 5.5 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 40.8333 to 51.0417 kN. Explain the causal direction for kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 局部速度事件配對~Pairing events for local speed
units.title: 局部速度事件配對~Pairing events for local speed
units.mechanism: 兩測點必須對應同一輪對，否則除出來的速度可能形式正確卻沒有物理意義。以模型車往返重播檢查配對和方向，保留接近停車時的模糊情況。兩個相鄰感測點的事件先後順序可提供方向，間距除以時間差可估局部速度。時間解析度與輪緣幾何都影響結果；接近停車或往返擺動時，事件配對比公式本身更容易出錯。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。~Both detector events must correspond to the same wheelset or the computed speed has no physical meaning. Replay a model wagon in both directions and retain ambiguous near-standstill cases. Event ordering across two nearby sensors provides direction, while separation divided by transit time estimates local speed. Timing resolution and wheel geometry affect the estimate. Near standstill or during oscillatory movement, pairing the correct events is often harder than evaluating the equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected.

For pairing events for local speed, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

units.misconception: 感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度~Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
units.practice: 只把通過時間差 dt 從 0.015 改成 0.0165 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變為 18.1818 m/s。先說明「局部速度事件配對」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only passage time difference dt from 0.015 to 0.0165 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 20 to 18.1818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for pairing events for local speed, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 速度資料年齡與位移~Data age and continued wagon movement
units.title: 速度資料年齡與位移~Data age and continued wagon movement
units.mechanism: 車輛在量測送往控制端的期間仍會移動，接收時刻不能重設量測年齡。將位移估算與原始定位界限並列，追蹤哪些誤差來自時序而非感測精度。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。~The wagon continues moving while a measurement reaches the controller, so reception cannot reset its age. Show age-related displacement beside the original position bound to distinguish timing effects from sensing precision. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.

For data age and continued wagon movement, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for data age and continued wagon movement. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置~A newly received packet always contains the present position.
units.practice: 只把資料年齡 t 從 0.25 改成 0.275 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5.1 變為 5.55 m。先說明「速度資料年齡與位移」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only data age t from 0.25 to 0.275 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5.1 to 5.55 m. Explain the causal direction for data age and continued wagon movement, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 輪周距離與地面行程~Wheel travel versus ground displacement
units.title: 輪周距離與地面行程~Wheel travel versus ground displacement
units.mechanism: 以獨立地標比較輪周累積距離，分離比例誤差和固定零點偏移。遇到滑移或不同輪徑時先質疑換算前提，不把平順數值當成真實位置證據。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。輪滑與空轉使輪周距離不等於地面位移；定期地標校正能約束累積誤差，但地標本身的位置與辨識可信度仍須驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。~Compare accumulated wheel travel with independent landmarks, separating scale error from zero offset. Question conversion assumptions under slip or changing wheel diameter rather than treating a smooth reading as ground truth. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow. Slip makes wheel travel differ from ground displacement. Landmark updates can constrain drift, but the landmark position and identification credibility still require verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled.

units.anchor: 反應段與耗能段邊界~Response and deceleration boundaries
units.title: 反應段與耗能段邊界~Response and deceleration boundaries
units.mechanism: 使用平直教學路段分開反應位移與定減速度位移，作為能量模型的交叉檢查。清楚標示此模型沒有坡道或變動調速力，不能替代真實駝峰控制曲線。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。~Separate response travel and constant-deceleration travel on a level teaching segment as an energy-model cross-check. State that gradients and variable retarding forces are absent, so this is not a real yard-control curve. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

units.anchor: 區段軸數與未知狀態~Section axle balance and unknown state
units.title: 區段軸數與未知狀態~Section axle balance and unknown state
units.mechanism: 區段進出軸數守恆只提供占用約束，不能告訴控制器車輛精確停在哪裡。將漏計、回滾和人工真值分開比較，零差值仍須具有可信的事件紀錄。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。差值為零仍需邊界感測器、方向判斷與狀態可信度成立；未知或故障狀態不能僅因兩個數字相等就自動宣告清空。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。~Boundary axle balance constrains occupancy but does not locate a wagon precisely. Compare missed counts, rollback and independent truth separately; a zero balance still requires trustworthy event records. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement. A zero difference is useful only when boundary sensing, direction and state validity are trustworthy. Unknown or failed states cannot be declared clear merely because two numbers match. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. units.anchor: 調速事件共同時基~Common timebase for speed-control events
units.title: 調速事件共同時基~Common timebase for speed-control events
units.mechanism: 把入口偵測、控制回報與出口量測放到同一時間線，先排除各儀器時鐘差。再檢查長時間漂移，避免把紀錄錯序誤判為機構先後反應異常。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Place entry detection, controller reports and exit measurement on one timeline after accounting for clock offsets. Check longer-term drift before interpreting reordered records as a mechanical timing fault. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. units.anchor: 車組任務與路徑狀態~Wagon-group assignments and route states
units.title: 車組任務與路徑狀態~Wagon-group assignments and route states
units.mechanism: 分開車組辨識、路徑保留和設備可用狀態，避免一個正常旗標代表全部條件。用小型離線狀態圖找出互斥任務和循環等待，不重製現場控制邏輯。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Separate wagon identification, route reservation and equipment availability rather than treating one normal flag as universal readiness. Use a small offline state graph to detect incompatible assignments and circular waits without reproducing field logic. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.

Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.

units.anchor: 載重與環境試驗邊界~Load and environment coverage
units.title: 載重與環境試驗邊界~Load and environment coverage
units.mechanism: 把假想載重、阻力與量測延遲獨立分層，避免所有試驗只集中在容易的組合。對未涵蓋的風、雨與車輛差異明列限制，保持推論範圍可追溯。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Stratify assumed load, resistance and measurement delay so tests do not concentrate on easy combinations. Record untested wind, rain and vehicle differences to keep inference within a traceable boundary. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
